title: Attractive Faces Skew Text-to-Image Reward Models and Leaderboards
title_zh: 迷人面孔使文生图奖励模型与排行榜产生偏差

paragraphs.en: 研究发现人脸吸引力会扭曲文生图偏好模型与排行榜结果，导致评分失真并削弱用户控制。 Human preference is now central to the evaluation, guidance, finetuning, and ranking of text-to-image models. However, the susceptibility of human preferences to bias in image generation remains underexplored. We identify a key observation: for human faces, perceived attractiveness overrides image quality in preference judgments, even when comparing real photographs of identical fidelity. In a controlled user study, annotators rank more attractive faces as higher quality, even when unattractive real faces are compared with attractive AI-generated ones. We examine the downstream consequences of this bias. Firstly, simulating Elo rankings from user study data shows attractiveness can invert a leaderboard's ranking, elevating synthetic attractive faces over real, unattractive ones. Secondly, the same bias reappears in the human preference models. Editing 40 annotated facial attributes in isolation, we find that attractiveness is the strongest correlate of score for four of five human preference models (PickScore, MPS, HPSv2.1, HPSv3), and the strongest predictor of score in regression analysis. We further show that preference aligned generation shifts faces toward younger, more feminine faces, and can override explicit prompts for unattractive faces, thereby limiting user control. Finally, we explore mitigation strategies, both for data collection and post training on human preference models. These findings highlight the need for preference models that disentangle image quality from human cognitive bias, enabling more reliable evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 研究发现人脸吸引力会扭曲文生图偏好模型与排行榜结果，导致评分失真并削弱用户控制。人类偏好如今已成为文生图模型评估、引导、微调与排名的核心。 然而，图像生成中人类偏好对偏差的易感性仍然缺乏充分研究。 我们识别出一个关键观察：对于人脸而言，感知到的吸引力会在偏好判断中压倒图像质量，即使是在比较保真度完全相同的真实照片时也是如此。 在一项受控用户研究中，标注者会将更有吸引力的面孔评为更高质量，即使是在没有吸引力的真实面孔与有吸引力的AI生成面孔进行比较时也是如此。 我们考察了这种偏差的下游后果。 首先，基于用户研究数据模拟Elo排名表明，吸引力可以颠倒排行榜的排序，使合成的有吸引力面孔凌驾于真实的、没有吸引力的面孔之上。 其次，同样的偏差在人类偏好模型中也会重现。 通过单独编辑40个已标注的人脸属性，我们发现吸引力是五个人类偏好模型中四个模型（PickScore、MPS、HPSv2.1、HPSv3）评分的最强相关因素，并且在回归分析中是评分的最强预测因子。 我们进一步表明，偏好对齐生成会使面孔偏向更年轻、更具女性特征的面孔，并且可以覆盖对没有吸引力的面孔的显式提示，从而限制用户控制。 最后，我们探讨了缓解策略，包括针对数据收集以及在人类偏好模型上进行后训练的策略。 这些发现凸显了将图像质量与人类认知偏差解耦的偏好模型的必要性，从而实现更可靠的评估。
